presets.json verification: When locating HandBrake presets.json with vm_command_line, do not return VM paths and open them in rule code; vm_command_line should emit stdout containing the JSON or parsed fields, while vm_file should be used only with a concrete file path that the evaluator caches locally.
custom preset JSON verification: HandBrake preset files may use a top-level PresetList wrapper as well as nested ChildrenArray folders; evaluators should traverse both structures when locating a custom preset.

When verifying a HandBrake preset based on a built-in preset, check not only the modified fields but also stable inherited preset anchors such as 720p dimensions and expected 30 fps/framerate-related fields when available, rather than relying on resolution alone.
preset JSON RF quality: HandBrake GUI preset JSON commonly stores constant-quality RF in VideoQualitySlider, not VideoQuality; evaluators should check VideoQualitySlider together with VideoQualityType rather than relying on a nonstandard VideoQuality key.
